summary.name: BigModel
summary.one_liner: BigModel (智谱大模型开放平台) is Zhipu AI's China-based platform offering its GLM family of large language, multimodal, image, OCR, speech and voice models through an API and product suite.
use_cases: calling GLM models via API for applications
image generation for posters and infographics
building AI agents with web search and knowledge bases
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Zhipu's GLM-5.3 flagship model, which it says improves coding experience by 50% and handles complex software engineering and agent tasks. It lists GLM-5.3-Flash, a native multimodal model for image and video understanding, and GLM-Image for text-rendering image generation. Specialized models include GLM-OCR for document parsing, GLM-ASR for real-time speech transcription, and GLM-TTS for speech synthesis. Platform features listed are an agent marketplace, web search, MCP, knowledge base, and model fine-tuning.
notable: GLM-5.3 flagship model with claimed 50% coding improvement
GLM Coding Plan integrates with mainstream coding tools
GLM-5.3-FlashX claims inference speed up to 200 tokens/s
Covers LLM, image, OCR, ASR and TTS models in one platform
caveats: Page text does not state pricing or subscription costs for the models or GLM Coding Plan
Performance claims such as 50% coding gain and 200 tokens/s are vendor marketing statements, not independently verified
Page is in Chinese and the listing describes it as China-focused
